best_for: Developers leaving Postman or Insomnia who want API collections saved as plain files in their Git repo, with no cloud account.
description:
Bruno is an API client for exploring and testing APIs, from Anoop M D and the Bruno team, released under the MIT license. Its makers say it will stay offline: they have no plans to add cloud sync, ever.

Each collection is a folder of OpenCollection YAML files, a format people can read and that shows clean diffs when a request changes. You can work with them in Bruno, in your code editor, in a terminal, or through an AI coding agent. In a company, Bruno runs inside the network you already have, so your VPN, proxy and firewall rules still apply, and license activation can go through your identity provider.

points.title: Your collections live in your repo
points.text: Bruno saves requests as plain-text files on disk, so you review, branch and merge them with Git like any other code.

points.title: No account needed
points.text: Bruno is offline-first and runs without a cloud account. An email is asked for only when you buy a license, to send the key.

points.title: Where the free version stops
points.text: The open-source edition is free, but its Git integration covers public repos only, it allows 2 workspaces and 5 OpenAPI syncs a month, and support is community-only.

points.title: Paid plans
points.text: Pro is listed at USD 6 per user per month, Ultimate at USD 11 and Enterprise at USD 18, all billed yearly. Ultimate has a 14-day trial with no card. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Fits CI pipelines
points.text: A CLI runs collections and writes reports, and scripts and tests run before and after requests. Postman collections and environments can be imported.

points.title: Install notes
points.text: Windows has x64 and Arm64 builds as an installer, an MSI for all users, or a zip, and the listing keeps 116 versions. Macs get Intel and Apple silicon builds. The Linux Flatpak is verified on Flathub but x64 only. macOS and Linux list only the current release.
